applies_why: The judge text discusses whether the challenged Matthew 1:16 point was answered and does not count it as an unanswered witness toward a broken link.
quote: the defender answered the beget-pattern and naming witnesses in [CR3] LINK 4 and [CR2] §5, and the challenger answered hēs in [DR3] C2.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The judge expressly says the relevant point was answered and treats the matter as underdetermined, not as an unanswered witness counted toward a broken link.
